page.title: Automation
page.subtitle: Let AI run tasks on schedule and free your hands

morningBrief.name: Morning briefing
morningBrief.desc: Weekday morning summary of repo changes, uncommitted work, and focus items
morningBrief.prompt:
Act as my morning briefing assistant in the current workspace:
1. Inspect git status and recent commits if git is available
2. List uncommitted changes, unpushed branches, or likely blockers
3. Suggest 3 clear focus items for today
Reply in English with a concise structure. Do not modify any files.

dailySummary.name: Daily wrap-up
dailySummary.desc: Evening review of today's changes into a short work log
dailySummary.prompt:
Generate today's work summary for this workspace:
1. Summarize what was done from git log / file changes
2. Call out unfinished or follow-up items
3. Propose up to 3 actionable next steps for tomorrow
Use concise bullet points. Do not change code.

weeklyReview.name: Weekly review
weeklyReview.desc: Friday afternoon weekly report from this week's commits
weeklyReview.prompt:
Produce a weekly review for the current repository:
1. Summarize major commits and feature progress this week
2. Capture risks, tech debt, or recurring issues
3. Recommend next-week priorities (up to 5 items)
Write it ready to paste into a weekly report. Do not modify repository files.
